title: landing-page
summary: Generate a complete, deployable landing page as a single HTML file using Tailwind CSS via CDN. Gather a brief, build a responsive and accessible page with suitable sections and interactions, then provide preview and deployment guidance.

title: gpt-tasteskill
summary: Requires a randomized, AIDA-structured frontend design with wide hero typography, gapless bento grids, and GSAP motion. It also mandates a preflight design plan before UI code and bans emoji and specified meta-labels.

title: product-showcase
summary: Generate a deployable, multi-page marketing showcase that explains a web app through real screenshots, workflow walkthroughs, and benefit-focused copy. Explore the app, capture its key features, then build and deploy a polished site with useful navigation, forms, and SEO basics.

title: image-to-code-skill
summary: For visually important website work, generate design reference images first, analyze them closely, and then implement a frontend that stays faithful to those references. Prefer clear, section-specific images and clean, readable layouts over compressed references, generic designs, and unnecessary UI clutter.

title: fastapi-endpoint
summary: Guides the agent through exploring an existing FastAPI project, asking clarifying questions, planning an endpoint implementation for approval, and then building the endpoint and tests. It emphasizes async SQLAlchemy, Pydantic schemas, dependency-injected authentication, and API test coverage.

title: storybrand-messaging
summary: Apply the StoryBrand SB7 framework to create and review customer-centered brand messaging, emphasizing clear desires, problems, guidance, plans, calls to action, stakes, and success. Score marketing copy against the framework and favor honest, specific claims over fabricated desires, exaggerated problems, or unsupported promises.

title: imagegen-frontend-web
summary: Directs the agent to create premium, implementation-friendly frontend design references with deliberate visual variety, consistent branding, and conversion-aware section design. Requires a separate horizontal image for each section and specifies how to plan, label, and deliver the image set.

title: fastapi-templates
summary: Guides creation of structured FastAPI backend projects using async patterns, dependency injection, repository and service layers, authentication, and testing examples. Includes templates for API endpoints, database access, and user management.

title: taste-skill
summary: The skill directs the agent to build distinctive, responsive React or Next.js interfaces using specified design defaults, component conventions, and motion and performance rules. It also prescribes visual patterns and interaction states, and requires a preflight review of generated UI code.

title: one-page-marketing
summary: Guides the agent to build a specific, actionable marketing plan using a nine-square customer-journey framework: target market, message, and media; lead capture, nurture, and conversion; customer experience, lifetime value, and referrals. Emphasizes measurable direct-response marketing, ethical claims, and systematic follow-up.

title: frontend-design
summary: Plan and build distinctive interfaces by grounding visual choices in the brief, reviewing the plan for generic defaults, and refining the result through critique. Apply the same intentionality to interface copy, accessibility, and motion.

title: copywriting
summary: Guides the agent in gathering context and writing conversion-focused marketing copy for web pages. It emphasizes clear, specific, customer-centered messaging and gives page-structure, CTA, and output-format guidance.

title: web-prototype
summary: Create a single-file desktop web prototype by composing the provided HTML seed and layout library rather than building the styling from scratch. Follow the specified planning, design-token, self-review, and artifact-output workflow.

title: frontend-design-principles
summary: Guide the agent to plan distinctive frontend interfaces before coding, then review the result against its design intent and craft standards. Avoid generic defaults and use context-specific guidance for the kind of interface being built.

title: soft-skill
summary: For UI work, create polished, premium-feeling interfaces with distinctive layouts, nested component styling, fluid motion, and responsive behavior. Avoid generic visual defaults and check the generated code against the skill’s design and performance rules.

title: top-design
summary: Guides the agent to plan and build distinctive, immersive web experiences using intentional typography, composition, motion, color, and performance. It also sets accessibility requirements and requires user approval before implementing custom cursors.

title: web-design-builder
summary: Guides the agent to gather web-design requirements, create responsive and accessible HTML/CSS/JavaScript designs, and verify them with Playwright MCP when available. It also specifies what files, verification results, and guidance to deliver to the user.

title: scorecard-marketing
summary: Use a four-step scorecard marketing method to design and improve assessment funnels, from landing page and questionnaire through personalized results and follow-up. When reviewing or creating a funnel, score it against the guidelines and identify improvements.

title: mobile-onboarding
summary: Create a three-screen mobile onboarding flow as a single HTML page, arranged in three phone frames. Follow the workflow and include the specified phone UI elements, with the final screen focused on sign-in or continuation options.

title: forge
summary: Use Forge to build small, runnable prototypes that validate ideas, relying on mocks where useful and keeping work ready for handoff. Prioritize learning and working demos over production polish, and report the prototype’s status, findings, debt, and next decision.

title: web-prototype-taste-editorial
summary: Shapes single-page web prototypes into editorial-minimalist, premium marketing or documentation surfaces. It prescribes a warm monochrome palette, serif-and-grotesque typography, restrained components, and subtle motion.

title: openapi-spec-generation
summary: Guides agents in creating and maintaining OpenAPI 3.1 specifications from design or code, validating API contracts, and generating SDKs and documentation. Includes patterns for reusable schemas, API descriptions, security, versioning, and validation tools.

title: 3d-web-experience
summary: Guides agents in choosing and building interactive 3D web experiences, including model integration, scrolling effects, and mobile-aware usability. Emphasizes purposeful 3D, mobile testing, fallbacks, and optimized loading.

title: made-to-stick
summary: Use the SUCCESs framework to craft or review messaging for clarity, memorability, and action. Favor a clear core, concrete details, credibility, emotional connection, and stories, and score messaging against the framework.

title: web-prototype-taste-soft
summary: Build soft-premium web prototypes with a silver or cream canvas, nested card architecture, pill-shaped CTAs, and restrained ambient motion. Follow the specified typography, components, responsive behavior, and banned styling patterns.

title: email-marketing
summary: Produce a single-column HTML marketing email guided by the active design system and the brief. Include the specified launch-email sections and deliver the HTML inside the required artifact wrapper.

title: banner-design
summary: Guides the agent through gathering banner requirements, researching art direction, generating visual assets, composing banners, and exporting PNGs for requested platforms. It also specifies design, file-naming, presentation, and security rules.

title: frontend-design
summary: Build distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces by choosing a clear aesthetic direction and carrying it through implementation. Avoid generic visual choices and tailor the design and implementation complexity to the intended aesthetic.

title: vibe-security
summary: Apply secure-by-default practices when building or reviewing web applications, protecting access, user data, inputs, outputs, and common application attack surfaces. Choose restrictive security options while preserving functionality.

title: cro-methodology
summary: Apply an evidence-based CRO methodology to audit landing pages and conversion flows, research visitor objections, and design rigorous experiments. Provide conversion scores and actionable improvements while prioritizing customer evidence, genuine proof, and ethical testing.

title: scroll-experience
summary: Guides agents in creating immersive scroll-driven web experiences with animation, parallax, sticky sections, and narrative structure. Emphasizes natural scroll behavior, restrained animation, and mobile-friendly design.

title: imagegen-frontend-mobile
summary: Generate premium, readable mobile app screen images and believable multi-screen flows, not code or implementation guidance. Maintain a coherent platform-aware design system, logical navigation, controlled visual direction, and clean phone mockup framing.

title: redesign-skill
summary: Upgrade existing websites and apps with focused visual, content, accessibility, and interaction improvements that preserve the existing stack and functionality. Audit for generic design patterns, make targeted changes, and test after each change.

title: social-carousel
summary: Create a three-panel, square social-media carousel as a single HTML artifact, following the active design system and the brief. Use connected cinematic headlines, distinct panel styling, and the specified carousel details and output format.

title: bright-data-best-practices
summary: Guides developers in choosing and integrating Bright Data APIs for scraping, search, structured extraction, and browser automation. Provides practical authentication, request, polling, and session guidance for Web Unlocker, SERP, Web Scraper, and Browser APIs.

title: design-system-creation
summary: Guides the agent through creating or refactoring a distinctive design system, from documenting its aesthetic to building tokens, typography, components, motion, and loading states. It favors custom visual choices and reusable design-system primitives over default styles.

title: prototyping-pretotyping
summary: Guides the agent to validate ideas and assumptions with the cheapest suitable pretotype or prototype before committing to full development. It emphasizes matching fidelity to the question, setting success criteria in advance, and testing with real users while observing behavior.

title: design-optimize
summary: Measure interface performance, identify bottlenecks, and apply targeted optimizations across loading, rendering, animation, network use, and Core Web Vitals. Verify improvements across real devices and network conditions without sacrificing accessibility or functionality.

title: epic-hypothesis
summary: Guide the agent to frame an epic as a testable if/then hypothesis, design lightweight experiments, and define measurable validation criteria before committing to a full build. If the hypothesis is validated, convert it into user stories and roadmap work.

title: pm-spec
summary: Create a one-page product spec or PRD from a brief, using the active design system and a structured layout. The spec covers the problem, goals, metrics, stories, scope, and open questions.

title: one-pager-prd
summary: Guides the agent in creating concise, decision-ready one-pager PRDs or short PRDs for product and feature proposals. It emphasizes clear problem framing, measurable success metrics, explicit scope, constraints, open questions, and stakeholder sign-off.

title: onboarding-ux
summary: Audit a web app from a new user’s perspective, then create onboarding guidance and code to address the gaps. Deliver the audit and generated materials in the specified artifact locations, matching the project’s existing patterns.

title: gamified-app
summary: Create a single-page, dark showcase with three distinct mobile screens for a gamified app: a cover, a quest dashboard, and a quest detail. Follow the specified visual and content requirements, write the prototype as one HTML document, and self-check its screens and tone.

title: gsap-scrolltrigger
summary: Guides agents in implementing GSAP ScrollTrigger features, including triggers, scrubbing, pinning, batching, and horizontal scroll. It also specifies configuration, refresh, ordering, and cleanup practices.

title: spark
summary: Spark guides the agent to create focused, evidence-informed feature proposals and prioritization documents rather than implementation code. It emphasizes persona fit, feasibility, validation, and clear handoffs to other agents.

title: pricing-page
summary: Create a single-screen pricing page as a self-contained HTML document, following the active DESIGN.md and the brief’s product and tier requirements. Include plan cards, a feature comparison table, an FAQ, and a footer CTA, then emit the artifact in the specified format.

title: hr-onboarding
summary: Create a single-screen HTML onboarding plan with a first-day schedule, first-week timeline, milestones, resources, and readiness checklist. Use the active DESIGN.md and identify role and tenure expectations from the brief.

title: customer-journey-map
summary: Guides the agent to create a customer journey map that captures customer actions, touchpoints, experiences, KPIs, business goals, and teams across stages. It also directs the agent to analyze, validate, and periodically update the map.

title: connect-apps
summary: Connect Claude to external apps through Composio Tool Router so it can perform actions such as sending emails, posting messages, and creating issues. The skill also describes setup and authorization for the integration.

title: design-to-code
summary: Guides the agent in translating design mockups into frontend code, prioritizing alignment with the design and the existing project. It also calls for responsive behavior, clear interaction states, reusable components, and noting necessary deviations.
